locator: A Further Reconstruction of the Fourth Way (2022-01-23), step 7
interpretation: Restricted reading of step7: in each root-accessible evaluation world v, among x and y currently present at v, if x can be a cause of y existence, y degree at v is no greater than x degree at v. The formalization uses one analyst-supplied preorder of degrees and represents causal possibility by an edge at some v-accessible u; the degree comparison remains at CURRENT v. Present-relata guards and the root-accessible domain restrict the sentence rather than strengthening its non-strict comparative. The source does not define a numerical measure or fix this representation. This is not the earlier unrestricted strict cause-more-such principle, and no actual current edge, unique causer, necessary individual, literal degree-label identity or complete metaphysical-world domain is asserted. The interpretation of the supplied Causes relation as existence-causation remains explicit; no adequacy of arbitrary relational interpretations is sourced.
